test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ANGLE' is written as 'CQKQK' and 'BEING' is written as 'DHMSM'. How will 'BROKE' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 **First alphabet is increased to 2 positional values.**

 Second alphabet is increased to 3 positional values.

 Third alphabet is increased to 4 positional values.

 Fourth alphabet is increased to 5 positional values.

 Fifth alphabet is increased to 6 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/582529c778dc2b1849ad0e8c6d2305e62507fb92fa1774018f470eb429b7ecfa.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00de7b95189dc5444bc5eca49aa9eca317c6937673e2967b5fbbaba03e642425.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af0b9b93b9a03786a3a3b913e968bb0a0de3659cd1cf3a4209070d8e923107a1.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **option 1)**
